change.title: Move cold one-click prior Science wait outside AppState with owner CAS
change.summary: Keeps the durable PriorStopIntent and typed outcome ordering while freezing the exact prior Science generation and complete process-local owner under AppState, executing the existing stop/TERM/KILL/wait policy outside AppState, and publishing only after generation plus full-owner CAS. Stale publication preserves replacement Science ownership, persists Unknown, and fails before authority snapshot.

basis: the credential-free durable PriorStopIntent remains committed before the exact prior Science stop effect and typed outcome publication remains after it

the cold coordinator freezes generation, runtime, confirmed-stopped proof, child PID, port, and URL under AppState, executes the existing stop policy outside AppState, and publishes only through full-owner CAS
the deterministic regression separately exercises generation-only and identity-only drift and proves AppState remains readable during the prior Science stop wait
stale publication preserves replacement Science ownership, persists Unknown, and returns before authority snapshot or later one-click effects
history, DB recovery, managed Science DB restart, compensation, and replay stop boundaries remain outside this bounded slice
